notes: Both occurrences of לְעֻמַּת are fused as compound prepositions rendered *even as* (rules 19, 30), headed on the construct noun and on the relational word *as*.
The opening waw is unrepresented: the ASV writes *These likewise cast lots* with no connective at the clause head (rule 14).
*those of* is one added unit for the elided *fathers houses* and its genitive link; the words stand together and do one office (rule 2), and the לְעֻמַּת beside them already holds its own rendering.
